segments.name: Mission critical equipment
segments.description: Designs and manufactures mission critical fluid, power, heat transfer, vacuum and advanced mixing technologies for Defense, Energy & Process, and Space industry customers.
segments.evidence: The Company has one reporting segment as its operating segments meet the requirements for aggregation.

revenueModel.text: Customers, including defense suppliers, refineries, petrochemical plants, engineering contractors and OEMs, pay the company for custom-engineered equipment, spare parts and services.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company also services and sells spare parts for its equipment.
